Description

Safari Omega Pro is a multi-purpose 3 compartment spacious laptop backpack with 35L volume suitable for College, office, travel & school. It comes with 3 front pockets and an organizer. It also comes with a rain cover ensuring protection throughout the year. All in all it's a fully packed product that caters to all your daily travel needs. Available in 2 color options, the travel bag is suitable for both men and women.
features: 3 spacious compartments with 2 front pockets and an organizer compartment
Rain cover, Bottle and umbrella holder pockets
Compression straps, padded shoulder straps and padded back for better travelling experience
Multipurpose bag - Ideal for office, college, school & travel
